scripts.build: npm run contracts:build && npm run abi && npm run sdk:build && npm --prefix web run build
scripts.test: npm run contracts:test && node --test scripts/*.test.mjs && npm run sdk:test && npm --prefix web test
scripts.deploy:local: npm run contracts:build && npm run abi && npm run sdk:build && node scripts/deploy.mjs local
scripts.deploy:testnet: npm run contracts:build && npm run abi && npm run sdk:build && node --env-file-if-exists=.env scripts/deploy.mjs testnet
scripts.demo:local: npm run contracts:build && npm run abi && npm run sdk:build && node scripts/demo-v4.mjs
scripts.typecheck: npm run sdk:build && npm --prefix web run typecheck
scripts.sdk:test: npm run sdk:build && npm run test --workspace @stock-options-lab/sdk
